label: NOTE: two dispatchers, so every mutation moves an offset, an argument, a loop shape or a truncation. What makes them separable is the SCRIPTED state: it records which function ran, where `out` pointed, what `*left` held on entry and which of two contexts was in force, and it can swap the context or install a successor mid-block so a cached read is visible in the trace rather than only in a pointer. `t_v32hdx.c`'s header lists the wrong reading each check is built around.
the context is read once before the loop instead of at every iteration, so a state that swaps it is not seen
the transmit driver dispatches from the RECEIVE slot
the budget is seeded from V32_SAMPLE_LEN instead of V32_SYMBOL_LEN
the budget is seeded from the instance rather than from the context
the running total is accumulated at full width instead of being truncated to a short every iteration
why: EQUIVALENT AT TIER 1 AND ONLY AT TIER 1, and the argument is arithmetic rather than a claim about this fixture.  `total` reaches exactly one observable -- `*nsamples`, a `short *` -- so whatever width it is accumulated at, what is stored is the sum mod 2**16.  Addition mod 2**16 is associative, so truncating after every term and truncating once at the end give the same sixteen bits for EVERY sequence of returns, not merely for the ones a real V32_SYMBOL_LEN can produce.  `out` advances by `n` and not by `total`, and the loop exits on `left`, so no other path can see the difference.  The claim is therefore a CODEGEN-tier one: the object encodes `lea (%esi,%eax,1),%edx` followed by `movswl %dx,%esi` on every iteration, which tier 3 reads directly and tier 1 provably never can.  Finding F8231.
